description: Defines the em_orch_ctrl_t class which manages orchestration control, including candidate building, pre-processing, cancellation, and state checks for EM orchestration operations.

classes.name: em_orch_ctrl_t
classes.description: A class that extends em_orch_t to provide orchestration control functionalities such as building candidates, pre-processing, canceling, and checking EM readiness.

methods.name: build_candidates
methods.description: Builds a list of candidates based on the provided command.

methods.name: pre_process_orch_op
methods.description: Pre-processes the orchestration operation before execution.

methods.name: pre_process_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the pre-processing of a given command.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_exec
methods.description: Checks if the EM is ready for orchestration execution.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_fini
methods.description: Checks if the EM is ready for orchestration finalization.

methods.name: orch_transient
methods.description: Handles the orchestration of transient commands.

methods.name: em_orch_ctrl_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the orchestration control with a manager structure.
